title: The road where Betty Byrne lived
html_source:
The 1901 census shows 241 Elizabeth Byrnes in Dublin County.

Little Stephen (falsely) interprets his father’s story as taking place on a road he knows personally. (Compare with his false memories of Oxford in chapter one of Ulysses.)
